content: Now that Grand Theft Auto 6 is out, players are discovering that Rockstar Games' latest feels more like Red Dead Redemption 2 than GTA 5. Rockstar Games builds on the work it did in its open-world western and applies it to the context of a modern city. That’s a big part of why it's so successful, but that might make some players nervous. While GTA 6 moves at a quicker pace, movement can still feel a little slower than you might expect.
